Squared autocorrelations are evaluated for all twelve conjugate shift representatives using exact 2cos difference formulas. Integer/Q(sqrt5)/cubic-Q(x)/Q(sqrt2) arithmetic and rigorous q=7 root interval yield total ordering without numerical tolerance. Exhaustive checker tests all 61,775 tuples and matches the complete stored optimizer catalog. The single-pair corner shift forces PSL≥1, and an explicit sixth-root matrix attains it. This is a fully proved finite-alphabet statement, with no extrapolation to untested alphabets.

value.rationale: The minimax aperiodic sidelobe is a natural worst-case radar/coding array metric, structurally different from summed sidelobe fourth-moment energy. The first attainment at q=6 of the universal |C(2,2)|=1 floor, its loss at q=7,8, and the full exact equality counts are intrinsic facts for the natural center-punctured 3x3 aperture, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The five-phase peak locus is substantially less rigid than the known fourth-moment locus (240 rather than four normalized orbits), indicating an independent design landscape.
